lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.focus: evaluating and interpreting statements in function notation
lessonRef.title: Guided practice A: evaluating and interpreting statements in function notation

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Use this example as the model for the guided set below.

items.prompt: What does the peak of a height-time graph mean?

steps: It gives the greatest height and when it happens.
workedSolution.answer: the maximum height and its time

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Work these with your teaching parent. Say the reason for each step out loud before you write it.

items.prompt: Does the set {(1, 3), (2, 5), (3, 7), (4, 9)} define y as a function of x? Justify the decision.
choices: No; the input 4 gives both y = 2 and y = −2.
Yes; repeated outputs are allowed, only repeated inputs with different outputs are not.
Yes; each input appears once, so each has exactly one output.
No; the input 1 is paired with both 3 and 8.

items.prompt: A machine starts with 60 components and consumes 8 per hour. It can run for at most 11 hours. What is the domain of C(h) = 60 − 8h in this context?
choices: all real numbers

items.prompt: A sequence is defined by a(1) = -6 and a(n) = a(n − 1) + 4 for n > 1. Find a(13).
In a modelling context, the graph of a projectile’s height against time crosses the horizontal axis. Which feature is this, and what does it mean?
choices: the maximum, giving the greatest height
a zero, giving the time the projectile returns to ground level
the average rate of change over the flight
the y-intercept, giving the launch height

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: Does the set {(1, 3), (2, 5), (1, 8), (4, 9)} define y as a function of x? Justify the decision.
choices: No; the input 1 is paired with both 3 and 8.
Yes; repeated outputs are allowed, only repeated inputs with different outputs are not.
No; the input 4 gives both y = 2 and y = −2.
Yes; each input appears once, so each has exactly one output.

items.prompt: A machine starts with 105 components and consumes 4 per hour. It can run for at most 31 hours. What is the domain of C(h) = 105 − 4h in this context?
choices: all real numbers

sections.title: Mastery check
sections.directions: Mastery check. Work without help, then stop and hand this section in.

items.prompt: A sequence is defined by a(1) = 4 and a(n) = a(n − 1) + 1 for n > 1. Find a(11).
In a modelling context, the graph of a projectile’s height against time reaches its highest point. Which feature is this, and what does it mean?
choices: the x-intercept, giving the landing time
the maximum, giving the greatest height and the time it occurs
the y-intercept, giving the launch height
an interval of decrease
